IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, loose blonde
waves stands indoors near a pale wall and a wood
floor. She wears a fitted burgundy strapless maxi
dress with horizontal sheer cut-outs at the midriff.
Gold bangles stack on her wrists, and a small gold
pendant sits at her throat. Her expression is calm
and direct. Soft, warm interior light. Palette of
burgundy, cream, and warm gold. Glamorous and
sleek, in the style of an evening wear campaign.
